families.title: Whispering Wilds lineage
families.evidence: Original Python text adventure, PyScript/static browser branch, Twine/Godot workspace, and modern React/Vite branch all identify themselves as Whispering Wilds. Parris-Tech-Services/Wild2 is explicitly excluded: it is DOVAHKIIN, an unrelated Skyrim text adventure.

families.title: Buckland Blocks lineage
families.evidence: BucklandBlocks README declares itself canonical. BucklandBlocks1 has identical README/package blob hashes. buckland-blocks-demo declares itself a generated distribution copy. BucklandGame is retained as a probable older relative, not asserted as an exact mirror.

families.title: JoshHub lineage
families.evidence: README.md and package.json blob hashes are identical in the two public copies.

families.title: The Consultancy Beneath lineage
families.evidence: README.md and package.json blob hashes are identical.

families.title: Campaign Copilot lineage
families.evidence: README.md blob hashes are identical; package metadata has drifted, so treat the second copy as an evolved mirror/variant rather than byte-identical.

families.title: HealthLens lineage
families.evidence: package.json blob hashes are identical; README content differs, indicating documentation/evolution drift.

families.title: Josh OS / firmware lineage
families.evidence: The canonical JoshOS README explicitly names all three repositories and assigns their roles: integration repo, Stage 0 product-track extraction, and firmware/bootloader research stack.

families.title: Ashfaller / AshFallen lineage
families.evidence: Both identify as ASHFALLER: The Veil Between, a text-led sci-fantasy extraction RPG beneath Dubbo; dependency versions differ, indicating variants rather than an exact mirror.

families.title: Elodin lore siblings
families.evidence: Both are Elodin-focused Kingkiller lore projects, but their READMEs describe different structures. Treat as sibling implementations, not duplicates.

families.title: Eleven Realms variants
families.evidence: Near-identical names. Eleven-Realms has a Vite package; ElevenRealms lacks README/package metadata. Keep as probable family until deeper history confirms.

families.title: DCS Companion copies
families.evidence: Same repository name across known owner identities. The Parris-Tech-Services copy has full app metadata; alternate copy currently lacks comparable README/package evidence.

name_collisions.name: Wild2
name_collisions.note: Confirmed collision: Parris-Tech-Services/Wild2 is DOVAHKIIN (Skyrim); dadlan-stack/Wild2 is a Whispering Wilds Twine/Godot workspace. Do not merge.
